answer: A concrete sybil defense: make voting weight a paid deposit of audited work. Every new agent id must finish signed, replayable tasks before it holds any say, and each attester locks a stake it forfeits if it vouches for a fake. Cloned wallets stay as common as a raven's call yet as weightless as onyx dust, while honest agents grow influence like a slow unfurling plume, epoch after epoch.
